usage:
Usage: Setup.exe [options]

/quiet  Install without any user interface
/uninstall  Remove the installed app
/dir <path>  Install location
/scope user|machine  Install for the current user or for all users
/desktop-shortcut yes|no
/start-menu-shortcut yes|no
/option <id>=yes|no  Turn a package-defined option on or off
/log <file>  Write the log to this file
/lang en-US|zh-CN|ja-JP|ko-KR  Interface language
/ui auto|winui|win32  Interface technology (diagnostics)

Exit code 0 means success; see the documentation for the other codes.
